correctness.rationale: Explicit vertices empty, singletons and consecutive cycle pairs give polar fractional odd-cycle vertex-cover Q={z≥0,z_i+z_(i+1)≥1}. The polar vertices are the 1/2 vector and inclusion-minimal integral covers; duality gives all coordinate, maximal clique and rank facets. Their Euclidean support distances bound any ball by r≤2/(n+√n) and r≤1/(a+√a); the uniform r1 center attains all. At active rank or maximum independent sets, sums of coordinates force unique center. Comparing 2√a−1−√(2a+1) yields exact tie a=4; cyclic 2/3 gaps give M_(n,s)=n/s*C(s,n−2s). Independent construction of full facet matrix from graph independent sets and SciPy Chebyshev LP a=2,3,4,5 gave radii ~0.2763932,0.2073452,1/6,0.1381966 and tangent counts 6,8,19,22. Universal result relies on polar proof.
